valores.label: Year of the Juneau road study (FSEIS and ROD)

fonte: United States Code (42 U.S.C. §4332); Alaska DOT&PF and FHWA
legenda: NEPA requires a detailed statement for major federal actions significantly affecting the environment.
nota: Lido no govinfo (edição 2023 do U.S. Code); o uscode.house.gov não abriu (tempo de conexão), e a Cornell LII do dossiê não foi reaberta.
divergencia_com_narracao_ou_fontes: Ressalva leve do dossiê (A17): a lei diz 'major Federal actions', mais amplo que 'federal project'. Não muda número.
narracao: When a federal project could significantly change the environment, federal law requires an environmental impact statement… The 2018 study for a Juneau road says travel limits feed the perception of an isolated capital.

conferencia.prova: "…include in every recommendation or report on proposals for legislation and other major Federal actions significantly affecting the quality of the human environment, a detailed statement by the responsible official…"

conferencia.item: isolamento e a mudança da capital
conferencia.prova: "These restrictions also contribute to the perception held by many Alaska residents that the capital is isolated from the rest of the state. Capital move proponents often cite this as a reason to relocate the state's capital."

fontes.provedor: U.S. Government Publishing Office (govinfo), United States Code, 2023 edition
